summary: Avoid duplicate model review across push and merge phases by reusing an exact, current, Host-attested tree-scope git_push PASS. Host merge checks and human approval remain mandatory.

components.owning_subsystem: HostReviewAdmission and HostVerifyAuthority; existing Provider/Runner and merge receipt pipeline.
components.disposition: Persist source push base/head/worktree on the Host-frozen review record. Reuse only a granted and consumed git_push PASS, when exact base/head/worktree/tree scope/content fingerprint, current policy digest, reviewer requested/observed identity, TTL and non-batch status all match. Host still revalidates lane and diff, requests browser approval, and issues the existing verify receipt. Any missing/stale/restarted/changed state falls back to a fresh merge review.
evidence: 3 focused tests passed, including exact reuse, no second reviewer spawn, host revalidation and human-approved verify receipt evidence.
Ruff and Pyright on production source passed.

Combined-tree original gate found start function size 87 to 88; fixed by carrying exact reviewed base and canonical Git root in existing Host-frozen push metadata, without changing baseline. 5 targeted tests passed, including real git -C cross-checkout binding and architecture ratchet. The final isolated candidate adds the consumed-admission requirement; three focused reuse tests passed including rejection of a granted but unconsumed PASS. Final full gate pending.
components.verification_level: Host-level unit tests exercise actual code-review record reuse and verify-receipt issuance; no production deployment claim.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: No reuse for patch scope, batch, stale or revoked policy, mismatched model, different worktree/base/head or changed tree. Reviewer unavailable does not create PASS.
components.rollback_route: Revert this isolated patch; original fresh merge reviewer remains fallback. No persistent schema migration.

g1.necessity: The same exact candidate was independently reviewed before push; a second full code review before merge repeats cost without new evidence. Merge still needs Host integration checks.

g2.authority_owner: Existing HostReviewAdmission PASS record and HostVerifyAuthority; browser human approval remains the issuance owner.
g2.non_duplication: No new reviewer service or receipt authority. Reuse the exact in-process source PASS and existing merge receipt pipeline.

model_evidence: Final broad regression and original full R9 pending.
g3.recovery_or_reason: If any binding or trust condition is missing, spawn the original independent merge reviewer; never widen scope.

verification: A.5, final full R9, independent review of this new high-risk gate change, protected CI and merge.
Production positive/negative validation with a previously reviewed identical push and a changed-head rejection.
